scope_summary: Shared bounded entry validation/host-only snapshot serialization, enum channel normalization, live/read visit distinction and existing-policy merge; no classifier/idle-boundary changes.

Both hosts retain optional visit context and expose consent-gated read projections without guessed first/direct. Live DO commits retain visitorId; restart/merge/manual/import/alarm/buffered paths preserve context.
Principal cold legacy reads return ephemeral context; owned personalization GET does not emit session cookies. Existing necessary refusal/config/connector operations remain.
SDK source and both owned bundles transport optional bounded host-only entry and strip it on readiness withdrawal; API documents bounds, precedence, unknowns and local limitations.
Exactly three grouped cases added (two route/object groups, one source+shipped SDK group); affected existing assertions updated. No new suite/framework.
lead_resolutions: Principal cold read uses ephemeral SessionData, preserving nondefault configuration validation and post-await signed checks; unsigned legacy/event path unchanged.
Manual segment and nonprincipal preference writers use observedLive=false, preserving activity/visit fields while retaining existing write/TTL semantics.
SDK serializes only within4096 JSON characters; oversize optional context omitted rather than failing hydrate.
Root approved both runtime fixture corrections and required lifecycle fixture correction; no production change after first fixed12 attempt.
